        (L if t==lid else O)[r['timestamp']]=float(r['value'])

    print(ts, L[ts], O.get(ts), 'ON' if L[ts]>1 else 'off', 'U' if O.get(ts,0)>0 else 'free')
n=sum(1 for ts in L if L[ts]>1 and O.get(ts,0)==0)
